about: Every AWS resource and data source type in this blueprint, mapped to the AWS service it belongs to. scripts/check_infra.py fails CI on any type not listed here, and on any forbidden type. HIPAA eligibility is AWS's list, not this file: an adopter must check the live page under their own BAA before storing PHI.
how_checked: 2026-10-21: the AWS page was unreachable from the build session (egress policy), so entries were first checked through web search. 2026-10-22: every eligible entry was checked against the live page (its 'Last Updated: October 15, 2026'), read by the owner's browsing agent because the build session still cannot reach aws.amazon.com; all 12 are listed there. 'official' means the AWS page itself names the service. Re-check every entry against the live page before relying on it.

AWS Fargate.note: listed for the ECS and EKS engines; this blueprint runs ECS on Fargate

Amazon S3.note: holds load balancer access logs only (IPs, paths, status codes; never request bodies)

AWS IAM.reason: roles and policies only; IAM stores no customer content

Account metadata.reason: read-only lookups of the account ID, partition and region

forbidden.aws_internet_gateway: no route to or from the internet
forbidden.aws_egress_only_internet_gateway: no route to or from the internet
forbidden.aws_instance: no servers to patch: Fargate only
forbidden.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version: a secret value in Terraform would sit in state; set it out of band
